name: std::vector<bool,Allocator>::swap

declarations.code: static void swap(reference x, reference y);

intro: Swaps the contents of x and y as if by bool b = x; x = y; y = b;.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
x

 -

 std::vector<bool>::reference value to swap with y


 y

 -

 std::vector<bool>::reference value to swap with x

examples.output:
swap elements of the same vector:
before swap, x: 1 0 
after swap,  x: 0 1 
swap elements of two different vectors:
before swap, x: 0 1 
before swap, y: 0 0 1 
after swap,  x: 1 1 
after swap,  y: 0 0 0

summary: Swaps the contents of x and y as if by bool b = x; x = y; y = b;.
